q: Which spotted Australian marsupials were given special toad sausages in experiments aimed at teaching them to avoid poisonous cane toads?
d: In a captive trial, trained northern quolls showed less interest in toads and fewer attacks. The bait was being investigated as a way to reduce encounters with dangerous prey.
evidence: Primary2018 abstract describes toad-sausage training in northern quolls and reduced interaction/attack behavior in captive tests. Field results establish bait uptake and aversion, not proof of universal population rescue. No preparation or dosing instructions.
